compatibilityPolicy.dependencyBoundary: generated project go.mod or isolated temporary test module
compatibilityPolicy.rollbackPolicy: Rollback by pinning the affected generator profile, discarding unclassified generated output, and keeping prior fixtures until the matrix gate passes again.

profiles.generatedOnlyDependencyPolicy: Generated REST dependencies stay inside the generated project go.mod and are checked before release promotion.
profiles.repeatDiffPolicy: Repeat generation must produce a clean diff or a classified compatible addition with rollback evidence.
profiles.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning the current REST profile and opening a breaking-candidate review if smoke fails.

profiles.generatedOnlyDependencyPolicy: Generated RPC dependencies stay in the generated service module and never enter the root module.
profiles.repeatDiffPolicy: Repeat RPC generation must remain clean across proto descriptor and control-plane smoke output.
profiles.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning RPC descriptors and preserving adapter output until generated smoke passes.

profiles.generatedOnlyDependencyPolicy: Generated model-only dependencies belong in generated modules or isolated temporary verification modules.
profiles.repeatDiffPolicy: Repeat model generation must not rewrite unrelated files or mutate the gofly root module.
profiles.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by discarding generated model output and rerunning the dependency boundary gate.

profiles.generatedOnlyDependencyPolicy: Generated production dependencies remain in the generated project and are verified by temporary smoke tests.
profiles.repeatDiffPolicy: Production scaffold repeat generation must classify any feature additions or breaking candidates before adoption.
profiles.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning the production template and holding release until generated project smoke passes.

crossCuttingChecks.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving alias-collision handling and rejecting generated symbol changes without evidence.
Rollback by removing generated-only dependencies from the root module and keeping them in generated projects.
Rollback by discarding unclassified diffs and requiring repeat-generation evidence before promotion.

profileMatrix.frameworkAlignment: go-zero compatible profile remains accepted for historical adopters.
profileMatrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning old fixtures and deferring generator promotion until smoke passes.

profileMatrix.frameworkAlignment: Current profile is the default adoption baseline for generated services.
profileMatrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by holding current fixture output and rejecting unexplained generated diffs.

profileMatrix.frameworkAlignment: Future fields stay experimental until generated smoke and rollback notes are attached.
profileMatrix.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by discarding future-only generated output and treating the diff as breaking-candidate.

edgeCases.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning the goctl-compatible profile and discarding incompatible profile changes.
Rollback by preserving route layout boundaries and pinning generated route placement.
Rollback by keeping API import and diff formats stable until migration notes are published.
Rollback by rejecting unsafe import path changes and pinning previous API importer behavior.
Rollback by preserving proto import compatibility and pinning protoc option handling.
Rollback by keeping alias collision handling and discarding generated symbol changes.
Rollback by removing root module pollution and pinning generated project dependency writes.
Rollback by discarding unclassified repeat diffs and requiring clean regeneration evidence.

adopterActions.expectedEvidence: Temporary generated projects compile, run smoke tests, and keep generated dependencies isolated from the root module.
adopterActions.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by deleting temporary projects and pinning the previous generator profile until smoke passes.

adopterActions.expectedEvidence: Repeat generation diff is clean or assigned to an accepted diff category with rollback notes.
adopterActions.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by discarding generated output and opening a breaking-candidate review for unexplained diffs.

adopterActions.expectedEvidence: goctl-compatible profile, flags, route layout, and API tooling remain covered by runnable tests.
adopterActions.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by preserving old goctl-compatible behavior until migration guidance is available.

adopterActions.expectedEvidence: API and proto import paths remain bounded and generated symbol aliases stay collision-safe.
adopterActions.rollbackOrEscalation: Rollback by pinning importer behavior and rejecting unsafe path or alias changes.
